madd_stress_benchmark.project: CuteCut Pro - Madd Stress Tests (Continuous Audio)

model_behavior.model_b_ctc_raw: At 320ms into the vowel, character logits for 'ا' flatline from 0.94 to under 0.08, replaced entirely by [PAD] blank tokens with probability > 0.95. The acoustic model enters a continuous blank-lock state.
model_behavior.predicted_boundary_offset_ms: Premature transition of word boundary by -450ms (Trellis slip)
model_behavior.h7_hybrid: Resists collapse. The duration prior restricts premature state shifts, and the global optimization path anchors the boundary back to the nearest energy minimum after the vowel energy decays.

model_behavior.model_b_ctc_raw: CTC logits drop to blank state after 410ms. Viterbi backtracking slips and maps 'أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ' 380ms too early, bleeding into the end of the vowel.
model_behavior.h7_hybrid: Stable. The duration-prior weights maintain the segment lock until the physical consonant 'أ' triggers a high-probability logit peak.
